python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', header=None)
# Expense rows are 11-22 (0-indexed 10-21): col0=category, col1=subcategory, col2=amount
exp = df.iloc[10:22, [0, 1, 2]].copy()
exp.columns = ['Category', 'Item', 'Amount']
exp = exp.dropna(subset=['Amount'])
exp['Amount'] = exp['Amount'].astype(float)
print(exp.to_string(index=False))
print()
total = exp['Amount'].sum()
print(f'Total Expenses (all categories): {total:,.2f}')
print()
by_cat = exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum()
for cat, amt in by_cat.items():
    print(f'  {cat}: {amt:,.2f}')
print()
print(f'  GRAND TOTAL: {total:,.2f}')
"
